state.task: Fill the empty over-track box (신맞이방 extension, 2010) of the Busan KTX station twin with its 2F hall and 3F level, 2022 epoch. Station frame: u points north (NNE), v points east (ESE, tracks, then North Port); y is height. The existing twin already has the main-building 2F hall (west of the box) with its own filmed 3F mezzanine.

facts.B1_shell: Box interior at y 14.2 is fully enclosed by original mesh (선상층부): polygon u -21.4..68.8, v 15.3..99.7, 6354 m2. No interior masses at 2F or 3F height except a thin partition line at u about -6, v 15..33, which appears at 14.5 m only.
facts.B2_levels: Deck structure band y 4.0-6.5 under the box. West wall (v 15-20, faces the main building): open from y 7.0 to 12.0 across u -12..52, solid 12.5-17.0. South end wall (u -15..-21): solid 6.5-18.5 with piers every 16-22 m. Main-building 2F floor = 7.0; main-building 3F mezzanine = 12.2.
facts.B3_roof: Roof underside: low band 16-19 m over the south wing u -21..0 (all v), the west band v 15..40 (all u) and the east band v 88..100. Raised 23-26 m over u 2..56, v 42..88.
facts.B4_gap: Between the main-building east wall (original mesh at v 6-12, y 8.5) and the box west wall (v 15-20) there is a 3-8 m gap with no floor in the original model.
facts.B5_naver_pins_3F: East band: Menmusha (32,92), EDIYA (22,91), Food Court (15,84), Bibimga (-14,89). South wing: Busanok (0,65), Egg Box (2.6,36).

facts.B7_3F_guide: L-shaped plan: a long row (계단, 멘무샤, 육수당, 북창동순두부, EDIYA, 빈츠38, 비빔家), a corner with W.C/EV, then a column (부산옥, EV, eggbox). Red railing runs along the inner edges. "3층 에스컬레이터" is labelled at the inner corner.
facts.B8_2F_guide: "3층 에스컬레이터" sits just below the top row of shops (Krispy Kreme, KAKAO FRIENDS, CAFFE PASCUCCI, exit 9, l'amant). Scaled against the pins, that is roughly u 2, v 59 (inferred, schematic guide).
facts.B9_walk_2023: RY2qvE0Tugk (2023-05). 2:49: escalator entry under a low ceiling beside the CAFFE PASCUCCI storefront, with large LED screens above. 2:53-2:57: rising with the hall on the right. 3:05: the 2F hall below, densely seated, with green departure boards. 3:17: 3F arrival onto a walkway along a glass railing over the void. 3:19-3:47: shops on one side, railing on the other; 부산옥 at 3:31. 3:51: 푸드코트 entrance. 3:59-4:35: food court interior about 20 m deep, exterior windows on the far side. 4:37-5:09: walkway along the railing. 5:11-5:21: escalator down along a glazed wall into the seated hall.
facts.B10_windows: 3F food-court window photos look east, directly onto the North Port park.
facts.B12_main_hall_separate: Hillside housing is visible through the west clerestory of the existing filmed high hall (2022 video, 98 s). That hall is in the main building, a different space from the box.
